# Arcade cabinet: a slate body, a tilted glowing screen, a control ledge with two buttons and a
# glowing marquee. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y, origin on the floor under the centre.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.2431 0.2549 0.3725 --no-slot
material new Screen --base-color 0.1647 0.6431 0.6667 --no-slot
material new Marquee --base-color 0.9176 0.3804 0.6157 --no-slot
material new Button --base-color 0.9529 0.7608 0.1255 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Body --size 1 --location 0 0.05 0.875
scale 0.8 0.62 1.75
apply --scale
material assign Body
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Ledge --size 1 --location 0 -0.36 0.92
scale 0.8 0.32 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name Screen --size 1 --location 0 -0.27 1.3
scale 0.6 0.06 0.46
apply --scale
set rotation -14 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Screen
add mesh cube --name Marquee --size 1 --location 0 -0.29 1.66
scale 0.8 0.08 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Marquee
add mesh cylinder --name B1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.06 --depth 0.06 --location -0.15 -0.4 1.0
material assign Button
add mesh cylinder --name B2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.06 --depth 0.06 --location 0.15 -0.4 1.0
material assign Button
select Body Ledge Screen Marquee B1 B2
active Body
join
shade flat
export cabinet.glb
